Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) has constituted the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to deal with complaint relating the sexual harassment of women employees and students at the university. To prevent the victim from being persuaded to withdraw their accusations by the offender(s), the committee accepts complaints from victims and maintains their confidentiality.
